faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.cta: I still have questions about the process

items.q: What therapeutic approach do you use?
items.a: I work with Contextual Cognitive-Behavioral Therapies (CBT, Schema Therapy and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy - ACT), offering personalized care for each patient and demand.
Currently care is private. After each session, I issue a receipt so you can request reimbursement from your health plan, if it offers that option.
Sessions take place via video call, lasting 50 minutes. You only need a device with a camera, stable internet and a private environment. It's as effective as in-person therapy.
Sessions take place at Avenida Portugal, 397 in Santo André, ABC Paulista region, lasting 50 minutes. Several parking lots nearby.

items.q: How does the therapeutic process work?
items.a: Goals are defined based on your demand. Sessions are weekly or biweekly, 50 minutes each, with total privacy and confidentiality. You not only talk about problems but also learn techniques to deal with them daily. We track your evolution, adjusting whatever is needed.

items.q: Can I do therapy living outside Brazil?
items.a: Yes! I serve Brazilians anywhere in the world. I also have personal experience with immigration and understand the emotional challenges of this process.

items.q: How do I book my first session?
items.a: You can book directly through Doctoralia, WhatsApp or by filling out the contact form on this site. I'll reply as soon as possible!
Adolescents from age 16, adults and couples.
